method: One city renderer. Documented places use schematic map-space rectangles until a source-dated contour is available. Point containment attaches a place story without dating all wings of the footprint. Demolished sites are excluded from current footprint links. Museum roof symbols are source-specific and never interpolated to 1942.
limitations: Not a complete historic building inventory.
OSM completeness varies between snapshots; first mapped is not built.
1942 has traced roads and individually dated house places, not a full roof inventory.
